title: Accuracy per 1K assembled tokens — the metric that judges all seven epics
summary: The ratio this entire arc claims to optimise is not currently computed anywhere. Land it early despite its position in the list.
description:
Add accuracy-per-1K-assembled-tokens to the benchmark harness and to the EPIC-20 composite scoring model (UNI-3): task accuracy divided by assembled token count, per LongMemEval and LoCoMo slice, reported alongside raw accuracy so a change that buys accuracy with tokens is visibly distinguished from one that buys it with better retrieval.

This is the measuring instrument for EPIC-27 through EPIC-33. Until it exists, no story in the arc can honestly claim to have improved the thing the research says we are improving — which is why, despite being listed last, it should be scheduled in the first wave alongside VIDX-3. The two are the arc's entire evidence base.

Acceptance: the metric is computed for every quality benchmark run; it appears in `project-management/BENCHMARKS.md` and in the UNI-3 composite; historical runs are annotated as not-comparable rather than backfilled with estimates, per this repo's existing discipline of never silently replacing a recorded run; the metric's own sensitivity to judge variance is characterised, since a noisy numerator over a precise denominator is still noisy. Depends on ASMB-1.
